answer: No, your dad doesn't need a notary. On February 1, 2026, the power of attorney form NW-POA-2 replaced the older notarized form NW-POA-1. NW-POA-2 can be signed electronically with no notary, and Georgia is the only state that still requires notarization. An NW-POA-1 signed before February 1, 2026 was only accepted until June 30, 2026, so your dad should sign NW-POA-2 now, even though an older help article still describes the notarized NW-POA-1. Bring the signed form with your own photo ID and the car's documents.
